title: Signal: tox installs no package
scope: A tox.ini file that declares a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
limitations: It matches a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact in the parsed tox.ini; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A tox.ini that mentions a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
